meaning:
πιστικός, -ή, -όν (πίστις),
1. having the gift of persuasion (Plat., Gorg., 455A).
2.
(a) of persons, faithful, trusty (Plut.);
(b) of things, trustworthy, genuine: νάρδος π., Mrk.14:3, Jhn.12:3.
† (AS)
